claim.claim-text: 1. A three-dimensional object having a shape of a bone and being printed from non-biological building materials, the object comprises a trabecular region at least partially surrounded by a cortical region, and a core region mimicking a bone marrow and being at least partially surrounded by said trabecular region and/or said cortical region;
2. The three-dimensional object according to claim 1, wherein said cortical region is made of a digital material combining a material C1 and a material C2 in a voxel-interlaced manner.

3. The three-dimensional object of claim 2, wherein said material C2 has a tensile strength of from about 20 MPa to about 40 MPa according to ASTM D-638-03, and a modulus of elasticity of from about 750 MPa to about 1500 MPa according to ASTM D-638-04.

4. The three-dimensional object according to any of claims 2 and 3, wherein said material C1 has a tensile strength of from about 50 MPa to about 70 MPa according to ASTM D-638-03 and a modulus of elasticity of from about 2500 MPa to about 3500 MPa according to ASTM D-638-04.
5. The three-dimensional object according to any of claims 1-4, wherein said trabecular region exhibits a stress variation of at most 20% over a strain range of from about 0.1% to about 0.3%.
6. The three-dimensional object according to any of claims 1-5, wherein said core region is made of a digital material combining a material M1 and a material M2 in a voxel-interlaced manner.
7. The three-dimensional object according to claim 6, wherein said material M1 has a 10 or less Shore A hardness, or a Shore 00 hardness lower than 40.
8. The three-dimensional object according to claim 6, wherein said material M2 is liquid or liquid-like.

9. The three-dimensional object according to any of claims 7 and 8, wherein said material M2 has at least one property selected from the group consisting of: viscosity of 10000 centipoises or less, Shear loss modulus to Shear storage modulus ratio greater than 1, Shear modulus lower than 20 kPa, flowability when subjected to a positive pressure of no more than 1 bar, a shear-thinning and/or thixotropic behavior, and a thermal-thinning behavior.

10. The three-dimensional object according to any of claims 1-9, comprising an additional structure on or near said cortical region, said additional structure having a shape of a bodily element other than a bone.

11. The three-dimensional object of claim 10, wherein said shape of said additional structure is selected from the group consisting of a shape of a bone tumor, a shape of a cartilage, a shape of a nerve, a shape of a spinal cord, and a shape of an intervertebral disk.
12. The three-dimensional object of claim 10, wherein said additional structure has a shape of a bone tumor and a core-shell structure.

13. The three-dimensional object of claim 10, wherein said additional structure is made of a material having a tensile strength of from about 20 to about 40 MPa according to ASTM D-638-03 and a modulus of elasticity of from about 750 MPa to about 1500 MPa according to ASTM D-638-04, and has a shape selected from the group consisting of a shape of a cartilage, a shape of a nerve, and a shape of a spinal cord.

14. The three-dimensional object of claim 10, wherein said additional structure has a shape of an intervertebral disk and is made of a material having a tensile strength of from about 2 to about 4 MPa according to ASTM D-412 and a Shore A hardness from about 25 MPa to about 35 MPa according to ASTM D-224D.
15. The three-dimensional object according to any of claims 1-14, comprising a coating over said cortical region, wherein a hardness of said coating is higher than a hardness of said cortical region.
